steps.title: Prepare buffers and culture medium
steps.instruction: Make all solutions listed in the Recipes section, filter each through a 0.22 µm filter and keep on ice or at 4 °C as indicated.

substeps.instruction: Digestion buffer (10 mL total): 9.9 mL HBSS, 100 µL Liberase TM (50 µg/mL), 10 µL DNase I (100 µg/mL). Prepare immediately before use because enzymes are temperature‑sensitive.
FACS buffer (2 L total): 1,980 mL PBS 1×, 20 mL 0.5 M EDTA (final 5 mM, pH 8.0), 10 g BSA (final 0.5%). Store up to 1 month at 4 °C; keep on ice during the protocol.
AutoMACS buffer (2 L total): 1,982 mL PBS 1×, 8 mL 0.5 M EDTA (final 2 mM, pH 8.0), 10 mL fetal bovine serum (final 0.5%). Store up to 1 month at 4 °C; keep on ice during the protocol.

Complete culture medium (500 mL): 435 mL D‑MEM, 50 mL FBS (10 %), 5 mL L‑glutamine (2 mM), 5 mL sodium pyruvate (1 mM), 500 µL 2‑mercaptoethanol (2 × 10⁻⁵ M), 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (100 IU/mL). Store up to 1 month at 4 °C and warm in a 37 °C water bath 1 h before use.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and harvest thymus
steps.instruction: Euthanize a 4–6 week C57BL/6 WT or OTII×Rag2⁻/⁻ mouse with 100 % CO₂ at 20 L/min, confirm lack of response to toe pinch, spray with 70 % ethanol, open the thoracic cavity, expose and gently excise the thymus, remove visible fat/connective tissue, and place the organ into a 15 mL tube containing 2 mL of digestion buffer (WT) or 2 mL cold FACS buffer (OTII×Rag2⁻/⁻).

steps.title: Digest WT thymus and isolate epithelial cells
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic digestion of WT thymus, filter, and clean the cell suspension before downstream labeling.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the thymus in 2 mL digestion buffer at 37 °C for 15 min.
Aspirate the tissue ~20 times with a 1,000 µL pipette tip; avoid bubbles and gently agitate.
Pass the suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL tube that already contains 3 mL cold FACS buffer.

Collect any undigested fragments from the strainer with forceps, return them to the original 15 mL tube, and repeat the 15‑min 37 °C digestion and aspiration step. Continue cycles (steps B3–B5) until the tissue is fully dissociated.
Centrifuge the pooled filtrate at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL red‑blood‑cell (RBC) lysis buffer for 3 min, then add 10 mL cold FACS buffer and centrifuge again at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Deplete CD45+ cells by magnetic separation
steps.instruction: Label CD45, bind anti‑biotin microbeads, and use AutoMACS to retain the CD45‑ fraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare biotin antibody mix No. 1: dilute biotin anti‑mouse CD45 to a final concentration of 2 µg/mL in cold FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL of this mix and incubate 15 min on ice (4 °C).
Wash with 10 mL cold FACS buffer and centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Prepare anti‑biotin microbead mix: 50 µL anti‑biotin microbeads + 450 µL cold FACS buffer.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL of the bead mix, incubate 15 min at 4 °C, wash with 10 mL cold FACS buffer and centrifuge as above.
Resuspend the final pellet in 4 mL cold AutoMACS buffer, pass through a pre‑separation 30 µm filter into a fresh 15 mL tube, and run the AutoMACS Pro Separator using the DepleteS program.
Collect the flow‑through (CD45‑) fraction, discard the retained CD45⁺ cells, and centrifuge the CD45‑ fraction at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Stain and sort medullary TECs
steps.instruction: Label CD45‑ cells with mTEC surface markers and sort the desired populations on a BD FACSAria III.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the mTEC antibody cocktail in cold FACS buffer (final concentrations): CD16/32 1 µg per 10⁶ cells, EpCAM‑PE/Cy7 60 ng/mL, Ly51‑PE 60 ng/mL, UEA‑1‑FITC 6.25 µg/mL. If subsets are required, also add CD80‑BV421 0.5 µg/mL and I‑A/I‑E‑Alexa 700 0.9 µg/mL.
Resuspend the CD45‑ pellet in 500 µL of the cocktail, incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Wash with 10 mL cold FACS buffer, centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and resuspend the stained cells in 500 µL cold FACS buffer. Keep on ice.
Sort total mTEC (or mTEC lo / mTEC hi) on a BD FACSAria III. Collect sorted cells into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes containing 100 µL complete culture medium.

steps.title: Isolate OTII CD4+ T cells
steps.instruction: Obtain a single‑cell suspension from OTII×Rag2⁻/⁻ thymus and prepare it for magnetic depletion.

substeps.instruction: Place the harvested thymus on a 70 µm cell strainer fixed on a 50 mL tube, add cold FACS buffer, and mechanically dissociate by scratching with the plunger of a 1 mL syringe.
Centrifuge the suspension at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL RBC lysis buffer for 3 min, add 10 mL cold FACS buffer, and centrifuge again at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Deplete CD8+ and CD11c+ cells
steps.instruction: Label CD8 and CD11c with biotin antibodies, bind anti‑biotin microbeads, and retain the CD8‑ CD11c‑ fraction using AutoMACS.

substeps.instruction: Prepare biotin antibody mix No. 2: dilute biotin anti‑mouse CD8 to 2.5 µg/mL and biotin anti‑mouse CD11c to 1.5 µg/mL in cold FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL of mix, incubate 15 min at 4 °C, wash with 10 mL cold FACS buffer and centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Prepare anti‑biotin microbead mix as above (50 µL beads + 450 µL cold FACS buffer).
Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL of bead mix, incubate 15 min at 4 °C, wash with 10 mL cold FACS buffer and centrifuge.
Resuspend the cells in 4 mL cold AutoMACS buffer, filter through a pre‑separation filter into a 15 mL tube, and run the AutoMACS Pro Separator using the Deplete program.
Collect the flow‑through (CD8‑ CD11c‑) fraction, discard the retained cells, and centrifuge at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Stain and sort OTII CD4+ T cells
steps.instruction: Label the CD8‑ CD11c‑ fraction with T‑cell surface antibodies and sort mature CD4⁺ T cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the CD4⁺ T‑cell antibody cocktail in cold FACS buffer (final concentrations): CD4‑BV421 1 µg/mL, CD8‑PerCP‑Cy5.5 1 µg/mL, CCR6‑PE 0.7 µg/mL, CD25‑PE/Cy7 0.5 µg/mL, CD69‑APC 1 µg/mL.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL of cocktail, incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Wash with 10 mL cold FACS buffer, centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and resuspend the stained cells in 500 µL cold FACS buffer. Keep on ice.
Sort mature OTII CD4⁺ T cells on a BD FACSAria III. Collect cells into 1.5 mL tubes containing 100 µL complete culture medium.

steps.title: Set up mTEC and T cell co‑culture
steps.instruction: Combine OVA‑pulsed mTECs with purified CD4⁺ T cells and incubate for antigen presentation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sorted mTEC tubes at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in complete culture medium supplemented with OVA 323‑339 peptide at 5 µg/mL (adjustable).
Dispense 100 µL of the OVA‑loaded mTEC suspension per well into a 96‑well U‑bottom plate (cell number per well as required by the experimental design).
Incubate the plate 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.
Centrifuge the sorted CD4⁺ T‑cell tubes at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and gently resuspend the pellet in complete culture medium.
Add 100 µL of the T‑cell suspension containing 1 × 10⁵ CD4⁺ T cells to each well that already contains OVA‑pulsed mTECs.
Incubate the co‑culture for 18 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.

steps.title: Analyze T‑cell activation by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Stain co‑cultured cells for CD4 and CD69 and acquire data on a BD LSR II cytometer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire co‑culture to a 96‑well V‑bottom plate and centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Prepare activation antibody mix in cold FACS buffer (final concentrations): CD4‑BV421 1 µg/mL, CD69‑APC 1 µg/mL.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 50 µL of the mix, incubate 15 min at 4 °C.
Centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 150 µL cold FACS buffer, and repeat the wash once more.
Resuspend the final pellet in 150 µL cold FACS buffer, transfer to a 5 mL tube, and acquire the samples on a BD LSR II flow cytometer.
